reason: The current codebase is a non-functional skeleton: the main() pipeline is missing, execution is blocked by an unterminated docstring, crucial entities are undefined, and no metrics are computed. There are critical logic bugs (WS k parity) and disconnected behaviors. Another iteration can yield substantial gains by implementing the end-to-end simulation, fixing execution, and adding evaluation metrics.

specific_areas: Fix unterminated Location docstring and ensure main() is called at global scope
Implement the full simulation pipeline (data load/synthesis, agent and network init, 40-day loop, daily state updates)
Define missing entities: Location, Retailer, PublicHealthAuthority, InformationChannel with required attributes/behaviors
Correct Watts–Strogatz k parity and bounds in network synthesis
Implement information diffusion with combined seeding probability and separate decay; integrate messaging intensity/credibility
Implement purchase-before-decision flow and immediate purchase attempt when adoption chosen but inventory is zero
Integrate policy activation/enforcement in daily loop and compute noncompliance
Compute required metrics including RMSE on days 30–39 and descriptive metrics (peak, sustained, inequality, availability, transmission reduction)
Add helper functions for neighbor share computation per layer
Add calibration step (logistic regression) on days 0–29 if train data exists; fallback to defaults when not
Remove redundant pass statements; add basic error handling/logging and deterministic RNG seeding
Ensure outputs: daily adoption series length 40 and metrics object serialized

task_understanding.adjustments: Reaffirm end-to-end deliverables: runnable simulation with mandatory global main() call, predictions for days 30–39, and full metric computation. Align implementation with the specified model plan and evaluation requirements.

data_analysis.adjustments: Plan for optional calibration using train_data (days 0–29). Handle missing/aggregate data gracefully. Define features for calibration (risk, info, peer shares by layer, policy flags, group indicators).

model_planning.adjustments: Specify concrete class designs for Location, Retailer, PublicHealthAuthority, InformationChannel. Define daily update order: restock → info diffusion → risk update → purchase → decision → policy enforcement → record. Define metrics and prediction window handling.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement the vertical slice to a runnable state using the provided code snippets. Fix WS k parity, close docstrings, implement classes/methods, and ensure consistent APIs across entities. Keep code minimal but complete.

code_verification.adjustments: Add checks for graph parameters, null data handling, and array bounds. Include simple unit-like assertions for network creation, diffusion update, and decision logic. Verify that the loop produces 40 days and no exceptions.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Use consistent RNG seeding. Ensure daily records capture adoption and relevant counters (stockouts, noncompliance). Maintain performance by caching neighbor shares from prior day.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Implement RMSE on days 30–39 if actuals available; otherwise skip gracefully. Compute peak/sustained adoption, inequality (e.g., Gini or between-group variance), noncompliance rate, availability rate, and estimated transmission reduction.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide concise, prioritized action lists and confirm fixes for critical blockers (execution, network bug). Summarize calibration and metric results after implementation.
